capabilities: Resolve a pasted URL into a rich markdown link with title and favicon
Resolve the selected URL or the URL under the cursor via a command or context menu
Show an inline loading placeholder while fetching page metadata
Render resolved URLs as preview cards instead of favicon-plus-title links
Ignore specific domains and exact URLs during automatic paste conversion
disambiguation: Not a link checker or repair tool; it only converts a URL into a rich link at the moment it is pasted or via a command.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README also covers local build, testing, and release steps rather than end-user troubleshooting.
problem: Pasting a URL into a note leaves a bare link with no title or favicon to show what it points to.
summary: URL-to-link converter that rewrites a pasted or selected URL into a markdown rich link with the page title and favicon.
